readings.reading: More free cash flow against an unchanged price is more earnings power for each dollar paid.
Steady volumes keep the business as it is valued; nothing here changes what it is worth.
A wider export rule is a risk to earnings power in one region, without a lower price to pay for it.
Returns under the tests leave little margin of safety at today's multiple.
Busy ratings desks lift cash in a business with little capital to fund.

value.note: Read on the findings' own words; no figure of the book is given.
value.sentence: 5 of 9 findings matter to a value investor; 2 favour, 2 cut against.

readings.reading: New cloud capacity is room for the fastest-growing segment to keep growing.
A wider cloud margin says the growth now earns as it scales.
Merchant growth held while the take rate rose: the market still to win is being won.
Agent payments would be a new flow on the same rails, early as it is.
A faster credit book is growth, and it is growth that has to prove its losses.
A licence cap slows growth in one city; small, but in the wrong direction.

growth.sentence: 6 of 9 findings matter to a growth investor; 4 favour, 1 cuts against. 1 reading dropped: it cited a finding not given.

readings.reading: More free cash flow, but it goes to buybacks; there is no dividend to cover.
Steady ratings cash covers the dividend with room to keep raising it.
Steady volumes keep the small dividend well covered.

dividend.note: Most holdings pay little or nothing, so few findings bear on this lens.
dividend.sentence: 3 of 9 findings matter to a dividend investor; 2 favour.
